requirements.text: Create a user-friendly experience for students to manage library tasks online.
Provide better tools for staff to manage inventory and generate meaningful usage reports.
Automate tracking of fines and overdue items.
Integrate with the existing student record system while ensuring GDPR compliance.
Enhance accessibility and efficiency of library services.
Enable students to search the library catalogue easily with real-time availability.
Allow students to borrow, return, and renew items online and view current loans and due dates.
Provide online booking for study rooms with date selection, time slots, and room capacity.
Send automated email reminders for loan due dates and fines.
Allow students to see their reservation history and any outstanding fines.
Provide a straightforward interface for staff to add, update, and retire catalogue items.
Enable sorting and filtering of items based on various criteria.
Generate detailed usage reports on loan volumes, item popularity, room utilization rates, and fine revenue.
Manage holds and restrictions on student accounts based on outstanding fines.
Automatically calculate fines for overdue items based on configurable daily rates.
Automatically enforce account restrictions for students with outstanding fines exceeding a certain threshold.
Send automated alerts or reports for librarians on accounts with significant overdue fines.
Ensure seamless integration with the existing student record system to verify student enrolment status.
Ensure careful migration of existing loan and student account data from the legacy system without data loss.
Adhere to budget constraints while implementing the new system.
